description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct, which manages error records related to segments of an HTML document. It includes properties for error details, child error structures, and methods to manipulate these error records.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorStruct
classes.description: A class for recording errors associated with parts of an HTML document, such as tokens, attributes, or CSS properties.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a child error structure of a specified type and identifier.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error with a severity and message to the current error structure.
